name: Georgia
spiritual_teacher: George Gurdjieff (Tbilisi — key city in shaping the 'Fourth Way', ancient mountain temples, mystical culture)
work_strategy: Remote (Unique regime: 1% small business tax up to k, visa-free entry and legal stay for 365 days)
it_market: Moderate (Relocated international IT companies, active freelancer community in Tbilisi and Batumi)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; after 183 days 20% PIT (Art. 104 Tax Code — working from Georgia via UA FOP counts as Georgian-source income, social 0%; single tax not credited).
climate: *Heating season:* 3–3.5 months. Cost with gas heating ("Karma") is only ~35–55 €/mo (significant utility savings).
nature: Top Sea + Caucasus (Black Sea right in Batumi, Europe's highest mountains — Kazbek, Svaneti, green subtropics)
english_level: Compromise (Youth and expats speak English fluently, older generation speaks Russian; Georgian is difficult)
housing_rent: Cheap / Moderate (~350–450 € in Batumi/Tbilisi, free market, easy to rent without a residence permit)

price_sources.summary: [Numbeo Batumi](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Batumi) (1-bedroom rent outside centre `~335 €`, living/food/utilities without rent `~552 €`, of which utilities+internet `~90 €`); heating — `CLIMATE_AND_HEATING_COSTS.md` (gas "Karma" ~45–65 €).
numbeo_mandatory_fields: Estimated monthly costs for a single person without rent (food, transport, basic household)
Basic utilities (Electricity, Heating, Cooling, Water, Garbage) + Internet (Broadband)

citizenship: 10 years (Citizenship is very hard to obtain, but the annual 365-day visa-free regime removes this issue)
mortgage_expats: Difficult (Banks lend to foreigners, but interest rates are high: 10–13% in GEL or 7–9% in foreign currency)
rent_to_buy: Available (Very common in Batumi and Tbilisi — direct installments and buyout from major developers like Orbi, Alliance)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: International passport grants **2 years visa-free stay** (entry from Russia counts as emergency, possible with any Ukrainian document).
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Refugee status (indefinite) or Humanitarian status (1 year, indefinitely renewable). Applying is optional thanks to long-term visa-free stay.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **Country is NOT in the EU. No EU directives restricting protection or sharing data of military-liable persons apply HERE.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: Housing allowance: 300 GEL (~105 €) per family + 45 GEL per person monthly (program extended). Does not apply to able-bodied men aged 18–60 (except fathers of large families / persons with disabilities). One-time child benefit — 470 GEL.
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: No free state housing (replaced by 300 GEL rent subsidy). Open-market rentals.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Law No. 1781 guarantees Ukrainian citizens free care: emergency aid, childbirth, vaccinations, oncology (chemo/radiotherapy), diabetes, dialysis, psychiatric and psychological care. Free medicines via Georgia's MoH and Just Help foundation.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: **Completely free travel** on public transport in Tbilisi, Rustavi, and Kutaisi (just show a Ukrainian passport).
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Any legally entered foreigner has an **automatic right to work without special permits**. Special small business tax regime (1% tax).

items: [Myhome.ge](https://www.myhome.ge/ru/) ([English version](https://www.myhome.ge/en/)) — most popular rental site (Batumi, Tbilisi). Filters by district, price, and heating type.

[SS.ge](https://home.ss.ge/ru/%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%B6%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8C) ([English version](https://home.ss.ge/en/real-estate)) — MyHome's main rival with a huge database from owners and agencies.
[Korter.ge](https://korter.ge/ru/) — interactive map of new builds and apartments in Tbilisi and Batumi.
[Flatio.com](https://www.flatio.com/housing/georgia/tbilisi/rentals) — monthly rentals for expats/nomads with no deposit, utilities included.
[Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com.ua/georgia/stays/monthly) — monthly rentals with discounts for the first 2–4 weeks for safe on-site searching.
housing_portals.facebook_groups: "Apartments for rent in Tbilisi", "Orenda Kvartyr Batumi" (Batumi rentals) — direct contact with owners.
housing_portals.telegram_channels: Dozens of Georgia rental channels with direct apartment video tours.

items: **Commission:** Realtor commission in Georgia is always paid by the **landlord**; search services are free for the tenant.

**Heating:** There is no central heating in the country. Must look for apartments with **"Karma"** (gas convector) or **central gas boiler/radiators** — 2–3x cheaper than heating with AC or electric heaters.
**Seasonality in Batumi:** In summer (June–August) prices jump 2–3x. Sign a **1-year contract in autumn or winter**, locking in a fixed price for all 12 months (to avoid summer hikes).
**Deposit:** Standard payment is first and last month. Deposit return terms must be clearly specified in the contract.

notes: **Strict conditions:** net income `600 / 750 / 800 / 1 000 €/mo` after UA FOP group 3; without opening a local 1% IE (since client pays only to UA FOP); horizon >1 year.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.first_183_days: Visa-free **365 days** (reduced in 2025/2026 from 3 years to 1 year; mandatory health insurance for 30 000 GEL ≈ 50–80 €/yr) — **0 €** local taxes. Independent of TP and military registration.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.legality_over_1y: Requires a visa run (exit/re-entry to Armenia/Turkey) — carries a risk of entry refusal at the border without a TRP.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.trap_after_183d_art104: Active remote work performed **physically from Georgia** counts as **Georgian-source** income, not exempt foreign income! Without registering a local IE under **1% Small Business**, **PIT = 20%** flat (social contributions for non-residents/non-citizens = **0%**). Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.verdict: **Ideal start for the first 183 days** without TP or certificates (0% tax), but after day 183 without a local 1% IE, **20% PIT** kicks in, and after day 365 a risky visa run is needed.
